title: Wonderful Tour with Victor!
text: We just came off a 10 day cruise with bus tours. However, the 3 hour private Tuk Tuk private tour with Victor here in Barcelona was the best tour we’ve had! So informative, maybe because he’s a history teacher too! We felt safe with his driving as well! Thank you for a wonderful day!
author: melaniemA2533OD

title: Great tour of Barcelona!
text: It’s fantastic.  Our guide eas patient and knowledgeable.  We tailored our trip to accommodate our ability to walk due to some mobility issues.  We learned so much and really enjoyed it.
author: Elana_M

title: Highly recommended
text: We had an amazing experience on our tour with Victor! He was an excellent guide very knowledgeable, friendly, and informative. He explained everything clearly and made the entire tour enjoyable. We especially appreciated that he never rushed us and gave everyone plenty of time to take pictures and enjoy the sights. Highly recommend this tour, especially with Victor as your guide!
author: shqiprima2026

title: Great city tuk tuk tour
text: Our tour guide, Elisa, was extremely knowledgeable and gave a great 3 hour tour. The tuk tuk was comfortable and we saw many of Barcelonas best sites and architecture. Highly recommend this tour to become familiar with Barcelona and to learn about it’s amazing architecture.
author: Dave_W

title: Best informative and fun tour of Barcelona!
text: Victor was fabulous! His English was superb and his knowledge of Barcelona, its history and its buildings was amazing! In four hours we were able to see so much that we never could’ve done on our own. The Turk-Turks are a great way to get around and can go on streets that buses could never go on. Victor allowed us to get on and off whenever we wanted and was really terrific in stopping so that we could get gorgeous pictures right from the tuk- tuk! Couldn’t recommend this enough and great value for the dollar/euro!
author: GrandTour01373464016

title: Terrific 4 hour tour of Barcelona’s best!
text: If you have limited days in Barcelona, this is the tour for you! The vehicle is comfortable and I was able to maneuver, narrow streets and the traffic of Barcelona. Victor was incredibly knowledgeable and we’ve learned so much. Could stop and get out whenever we wanted. Blankets were provided for our comfort and we had a gorgeous day. Saw so much that if we had tried to do on our own would have taken days. And because it was just us in the Driver, he was able to stop and customize it for us. We wouldn’t have been able to do that on a big tour bus. Can’t recommend enough!
author: Nancy_I

title: Experience
text: Dany was the best guide, thanks to him for this beautiful experience
author: amiramJ6774WY

title: Easily recommended
text: Easy pick up point, plenty of space on the vehicle and funny vibes with Danny, we recommend doing it early in the morning to avoid traffic.
author: THOIRS

title: Pleasant and interesting
text: First time in Barcelona with my wife and Danny was very helpful and kind, he impressively spoke many languages and made us feel comfortable and safe throughout the tour. The tour itself is not too long and rich in details and curiosities. Can be done between breakfast and lunch or lunch and coffee.
author: BrooklynNtv82

title: Danny is best!
text: The meet up was a little confusing at first but after learning about the current protest it caused our tour guide to run a tad late. After figuring out the issue the rest of the guide was fantastic. Danny was our guide and  showed us Barcelona that I would’ve never thought to see or have time to see. My first time here and I will never forget it. Thank you so much for a great experience.
author: tmI8960BA
